We Care We Respect We Achieve
21st Century Teaching blended with Traditional Values
Welcome to The Mountbatten School - an impressive community school with high expectations situated against the beautiful backdrop of the Broadlands estate near Romsey, at the southern tip of the Test Valley. Ours is a 21st century school built on traditional values, delivering a contemporary and dynamic curriculum.
Mountbatten became an academy school in 2011. As an international school, our students’ learning is rich in cultural diversity and global context. The sports ethos focuses on personal health, fitness and well-being, in addition to encouraging sports competition and promoting team spirit.

Smartphone-Free Childhood
Please note: this page is currently under development and may be subject to change. If you have any questions, please contact info@mountbatten.school
Mobile Phone Policy Update – Smartphone-Free from September 2026
From September 2026, The Mountbatten School will become a smartphone-free site. This change follows updated national guidance, growing research around the impact of early smartphone use on young people’s mental health and wellbeing, and a shared commitment across the Romsey Partnership of schools to create a focused, safe and supportive learning environment.
Our three key reasons for this are:
From this date, students will only be permitted to bring one of three approved non-smart mobile phones. These devices do not have internet access, social media apps or cameras, helping to reduce distractions and safeguard students during the school day.
We are committed to working closely with families to prepare students for this transition and to promote healthy digital habits. By working together as a school community, we can ensure our young people learn and grow in an environment free from the pressures and distractions that smartphones can bring.
The Department for Education guidance can be found here.

Watches & Trackers
Smartwatches will not be permitted in school. This change supports our wider approach to reducing distractions and maintaining a focused learning environment throughout the school day.
Students may wear analogue or standard digital watches that provide timekeeping functions only. Devices with smart capabilities, including internet access, messaging, cameras or app functionality, will not be allowed.
For students who require alarms or reminders during the day, simple digital watches with alarm functions are permitted. These provide the necessary support without the additional features found in smartwatches.
By maintaining clear and consistent expectations around wearable technology, we can help ensure that the school environment remains focused on learning and free from unnecessary digital distractions.
Vibratime - Silent Digital Vibrating Alarm Watch
We recognise that some parents may have concerns about specific needs, such as knowing their child's location for safety. If you feel you need to monitor your child’s location, we can support the use of dedicated Bluetooth tracking devices if needed for peace of mind such as;

Personal Best Education
Personal Best Education is the partner organisation of The Mountbatten School founded on similar core values and goals which we consider fundamental to building a better world for all, both in the present and the future. Personal Best’s principle aim is to ensure these key elements are attainable for everyone from all walks of life through our extensive services such as equipping young people for the challenges of the future world, participation in sports and leisure activities, to promoting healthy living or initiatives to help overcome or alleviate ‘real’ societal issues.
Personal Best’s vast range of provision, including junior courses, adult classes and facilities hire, can be viewed on our website by clicking here all of which are aligned with some or all of the following central themes:
Whatever your individual or collective background, goals or aspirations, our mission is to enable you to be the best version of yourself and achieve your Personal Best!

Student Absence
To report an absence, please call 01794 502502 (and press 1) before 9am on the day of your child’s absence or alternatively email attendance@mountbatten.school.
Requesting Leave of Absence
Any request for a leave of absence during term time must be made in advance using The Mountbatten School 'Request to Authorise Absence from School due to Exceptional Circumstances' form, which is available from Student Services and may also be downloaded below. The completed form should be submitted to the Attendance Office, who along with the Headteacher, will approve the request if there are exceptional circumstances. If the absence is not approved as exceptional circumstances then please see the parent information leaflet below regarding Penalty Notices. You may incur a fine if there are more than 10 sessions (5 days) of absence.

Extra-Curricular
The formal school curriculum is enhanced by many activities, e.g. Music, Sport, Drama, use of Library and IT rooms. The Library is open daily to all year groups, before school, at am and pm breaktimes. Please note that a late bus is available, leaving school promptly at 16:30. Students must book a place using the form – more information can be found here. Please note that activities can be subject to change throughout the academic year.
